extraction_notes: Excluded CO methanation-only stability data in Figure 5c and theoretical/reactor-modeling results in Figures 10-11 because they are not experimental CO2 methanation performance entries. Figure 5a,b values are approximate visual readings from the plotted markers. Table 3 TOF values were merged into the corresponding 250 °C Figure 5 entries and the 10^-2 multiplier in the column header was applied. Table 4 mean residence times are not represented because the schema has no residence-time field. The text states the catalysts were stable for 35 h in CO2 methanation at 350 °C in Supporting Information Figure S10, but no initial/final conversion values are printed in the provided paper text, so no stability record was added.
